title: RenderSettings
description: Mirrors hayro::RenderSettings field-for-field except bg_color. Every field is optional; an absent field means "use hayro's default for it". This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the RenderSettingsJson struct in src/lib.rs, not something validated against at runtime — serde's own typed deserialization there already rejects anything this schema would catch (wrong types, out-of-range numbers, unknown fields).

x_scale.description: Horizontal scale factor. Absent means "use hayro's default" (1.0). An explicit 0.0 is honored literally (producing a zero-area, and thus failing, render) - it is not treated the same as absent.

y_scale.description: Vertical scale factor. Absent means "use hayro's default" (1.0). Same explicit-zero handling as x_scale.

width.description: Target pixel width. Absent means "auto" (derived from the page size and scale).

height.description: Target pixel height. Absent means "auto" (derived from the page size and scale).

bg_color.description: Background color. Absent means "use hayro's default" (i.e. #00000000 - fully transparent black).

rgba.description: Straight (non-premultiplied) alpha, matching Go's image/color.NRGBA, not color.RGBA (which is premultiplied).
